basic_profile.bio: I'm a recent college graduate from Portland, Oregon, with a degree in Creative Writing. I have a huge passion for storytelling, especially in horror and sci-fi genres. In my free time, I love gaming and diving into lore-rich universes, and I recently got into Reddit to connect with communities that share these interests. I'm a part-time barista while I look for a full-time job in publishing. I'm single and usually online during evenings and weekends. My dislikes include spoilers and overly complex game mechanics.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've been a fan of horror and action genres since I was a kid, consuming a lot of movies, games, and books. Most of my knowledge comes from self-teaching through media consumption and participating in online forums. I also attended a few creative writing workshops during college that helped hone my storytelling skills.
